patch.value: GH-1555: refuse assignment-only linked-test commands before recording false passes

The October23 report shows test --add status=passed being interpreted as a shell assignment, then recorded as passing without executing a test. Investigate strict linked-command admission and typed metadata-typo recovery without restricting legitimate environment-prefixed executable commands.

A current SDK/CLI regression reproduces assignment-only false pass admission; Refusal or no-executable verdict is typed and actionable before false success is recorded; Environment-prefixed real commands and sandbox/trust controls remain supported.
Assignment-only metadata typos cannot become unqualified durable verification passes; legitimate environment assignments followed by an executable retain their existing behavior.

patch.value: Refuse metadata-only commands without durable writes or false pass receipts while retaining executable environment prefixes and explicit selectors.
Shared SDK admission rejects plain assignment-only commands at registration and legacy execution; selected effective entries are checked under the write lock before combined edits persist.

Linked suite passes 42 tests; focused regressions and installed npm/npx plus bun/bunx consumers verify refusal without writes and valid execution. Static components pass; GitHub full coverage and required checks remain merge conditions.
